title: Vogue Elegance
objective: Generate a professional landing page for digital product.

admin.behavior: A visible self-contained Google-style login button accepts Gmail addresses without external auth scripts. Admin inventory lists render only when vogueEleganceUserEmail exactly matches the allowed email.

dataNotes.shopBrand: The public storefront is branded as Vogue Elegance.
dataNotes.productSource: New-arrival product names, INR prices, compare-at prices, and sale or sold-out labels were checked from public Magnolia Bags new-arrivals pages on June 25, 2026.
dataNotes.cart: Available products include Add+ buttons, quantity controls, cart totals, and a checkout popup.
dataNotes.payments: The checkout popup lists standard payment choices including UPI, credit/debit card, net banking, wallets, EMI, and cash on pickup without collecting credentials.
dataNotes.invoice: The invoice view shows item totals, subtotal, GST at 18%, shipping or pickup fee, and payable total.
dataNotes.imagery: Product photos are stored locally under src/generated/assets so the app does not request remote images at runtime.
dataNotes.map: The contact section links to the requested real Google Maps location and uses a local themed map illustration instead of a tracking iframe.
dataNotes.navigation: The Location link was removed from the navigation bar; map access remains inside the contact section.
dataNotes.security: No credentials, tracking scripts, or backend calls are embedded.

fileOperations.reason: Render the Vogue Elegance storefront with Add+ product buttons, local cart state, checkout popup, payment options, GST calculation, invoice view, and existing admin inventory controls.
Apply responsive premium storefront styling for catalog cards, cart panel, checkout modal, payment options, invoice view, and themed map/card layouts.
Store brand, contact, product, GST, payment method, material, and source data separately from the React page.
Store local product photos for self-contained rendering.
Document the generated app handoff and current orchestrator plan.
Record build metadata and orchestrator handoff details.
Remove obsolete generated page modules if present.
